title: kbingest map leaves the MSBuild NuGet SDK resolver able to fetch an SDK
goal: NETWORK_OFF sets MSBUILDDISABLENUGETSDKRESOLVER=1, so a versioned Sdk="Name/1.2.3" reference or a global.json msbuild-sdks entry cannot make evaluation query package feeds and import an SDK package (the proxy variables are the only barrier today); a missing SDK becomes a note; a test named kbingest_map_dotnet_no_sdk_resolver asserts the variable reaches dotnet, and a planted removal fails it. The variable is read by the NuGet SDK resolver in the current implementation only (kb: agents/codebase-mapping.md:128, CODE S-7j4xac2a; no Microsoft Learn page documents it, gap entry open), so the code comment says so (sprint SP-fkyrld5h review finding F5)
links: kb/public/agents/codebase-mapping.md:128 (MSBUILDDISABLENUGETSDKRESOLVER, CODE S-7j4xac2a; no Learn page)
